description: Create, update, or manage GitLab projects. Actions: create (new project with settings), fork (copy existing project), update (modify settings, including GitLab Duo settings such as automatic Duo code review; any Duo setting GitLab could not apply is listed in not_applied with what it requires), delete (remove permanently), restore (recover a soft-deleted project before purge), archive/unarchive (toggle read-only), transfer (move to different namespace). Related: browse_projects for discovery.

action.description: Action to perform: create, fork, update, delete, archive, unarchive, transfer, restore

auto_duo_code_review_enabled.description: Premium+: run GitLab Duo code review automatically on every merge request. Needs a Duo Enterprise add-on or Duo Agent Platform code review. Required for 'update' action(s).

default_branch.description: Set default branch name. Required for 'update' action(s).

description.description: New project description. Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

duo_dependency_bump_breaking_changes_ena.description: Ultimate: let GitLab Duo resolve breaking changes introduced by dependency version bumps. Required for 'update' action(s).

duo_remote_flows_enabled.description: Premium+: allow GitLab Duo Agent Platform flows to run in this project. Required for 'update' action(s).

duo_sast_fp_detection_enabled.description: Ultimate: let GitLab Duo flag likely false positives in SAST findings. Required for 'update' action(s).

duo_sast_vr_workflow_enabled.description: Ultimate: let GitLab Duo run the SAST vulnerability resolution workflow. Required for 'update' action(s).

duo_secret_detection_fp_enabled.description: Ultimate: let GitLab Duo flag likely false positives in secret detection findings. Required for 'update' action(s).

fork_name.description: New name for forked project (maps to API 'name' parameter). Required for 'fork' action(s).

fork_path.description: New path for forked project (maps to API 'path' parameter). Required for 'fork' action(s).

initialize_with_readme.description: Create initial README.md file. Required for 'create' action(s).

issues_enabled.description: Enable issue tracking. Required for 'create', 'fork', 'update' action(s).

issues_template.description: Premium+: default description template for new issues. Required for 'update' action(s).

jobs_enabled.description: Enable CI/CD jobs. Required for 'create', 'fork', 'update' action(s).

lfs_enabled.description: Enable Git LFS. Required for 'create', 'fork', 'update' action(s).

merge_pipelines_enabled.description: Premium+: enable merged results pipelines. Required for 'update' action(s).

merge_requests_enabled.description: Enable merge requests. Required for 'create', 'fork', 'update' action(s).

merge_requests_template.description: Premium+: default description template for new merge requests. Required for 'update' action(s).

merge_trains_enabled.description: Premium+: enable merge trains (requires merge_pipelines_enabled). Required for 'update' action(s).

name.description: New project name. Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

namespace.description: Target namespace path. Omit for current user namespace. Required for 'create', 'fork', 'transfer' action(s).

namespace_path.description: Target namespace path for fork. Required for 'fork' action(s).

only_allow_merge_if_all_discussions_are_.description: Require resolved discussions for merge. Required for 'create', 'fork', 'update' action(s).

only_allow_merge_if_all_status_checks_pa.description: Ultimate: block merge until all external status checks pass. Required for 'update' action(s).

only_allow_merge_if_pipeline_succeeds.description: Require passing pipelines for merge. Required for 'create', 'fork', 'update' action(s).

project_id.description: Project ID or URL-encoded path of the project to restore. Required for 'fork', 'update', 'delete', 'archive', 'unarchive', 'transfer', 'restore' action(s).

request_access_enabled.description: Allow access requests. Required for 'create', 'fork', 'update' action(s).

requirements_access_level.description: Ultimate: requirements management access level. Required for 'update' action(s).

snippets_enabled.description: Enable code snippets. Required for 'create', 'fork', 'update' action(s).

visibility.description: Project visibility level. Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

wiki_enabled.description: Enable project wiki. Required for 'create', 'fork', 'update' action(s).

name: manage_project
